correctness.rationale: Sanna (2016) Corollary 1.6 yields the exact odd-prime valuation at every rank including ramified p|P²+4, where z=p. The separately proved companion doubling argument gives ν₂(U_n)=ν₂(P)+ν₂(n)−1 at even n. Divisibility-indicator expansions have unique Möbius transforms, proving all coefficients and their positivity. Exact necessary/sufficient repair factors follow at n=zp or n=z and at n=2, respectively. Split/unramified and inert/ramified root-order arguments prove the Legendre-symbol criterion; P²<P²+4<(P+1)² gives the nontrivial quadratic character and density 1/2. A new standalone stdlib verifier directly tests 17,280 coefficient equations (P even 2..18, p≤53, n≤120), but no finite test is treated as proof. Residual mathematical risk: reliance on the cited standard valuation theorem and usual AP prime-splitting density.

The theorem gives a complete closed local orbit-count spectrum and sharp least integer repairs for all primes and all indices, with a ramification analysis and the unavoidable binary exception; the density remains uniform across infinitely many nonsquare discriminants. It is not merely a fixed table, small improvement, or formal renaming.
